 Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI.  By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.
   

  

**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**
 Box’s Edge team powers the connectivity behind our products, including Box Zones and applications hosted across our environment. We’re evolving from a ticket\-driven support model to building automated, self\-serve network capabilities that application and service owners can consume reliably at scale. We’re looking for a Software Engineer III to design and build backend services and automation that turn complex network functionality into simple, safe, and repeatable workflows. * Write tests, documentation, and runbooks to support operational excellence and maintainability.
* Contribute to roadmap planning and continuous improvement of network automation patterns and standards.
* Participate in our on\-call rotation, available at all times while on\-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise.

* Proficient in Python with a track record of building production\-grade services or automation.
* Hands\-on with Infrastructure as Code, especially Terraform, including module design, reviews, and CI/CD integration.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (e.g., TCP/IP, routing vs. switching concepts, DNS, load balancing, security groups/firewalls).
* Product mindset: you distill complex systems into safe, reusable abstractions and prioritize user experience for internal customers.

About the Role
As a member of the Data team, you will build the services, infrastructure, and data platforms that power our business. Our team is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and distributing large volumes of data reliably and efficiently, enabling teams across the business to make data-driven decisions and build innovative products.
This role sits at the intersection of backend software engineering and data engineering. You will develop scalable backend services, design and maintain data pipelines, and build the underlying data infrastructure that enables reliable, cost-effective, and high-performance data processing.
You'll work closely with other engineering teams, data consumers, and infrastructure specialists to build robust solutions that balance technical excellence with delivering business value. While the role involves technical collaboration across the organization, it is primarily focused on engineering rather than stakeholder management.
We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and can make pragmatic engineering decisions that maximize impact.
This will be a full-time role, owning the following responsibilities :
Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and APIs in Python that support data ingestion, processing, and distribution.
Building and maintaining reliable data ingestion pipelines for structured and unstructured data from a wide variety of internal and external sources.
Developing reusable frameworks and tooling that simplify onboarding new data sources and improve developer productivity.
Designing and optimizing scalable data platforms, including databases, data lakes, metadata catalogues, and storage solutions.
Continuously improving the reliability, scalability, observability, and cost-efficiency of our data infrastructure.
Integrating data across multiple systems while reducing duplication and ensuring high data quality.
Developing and maintaining orchestration workflows and automated data processing pipelines.
Building internal libraries and services that enable other engineering teams to access and consume data efficiently.
Monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing production systems and data pipelines.
Contributing to architecture discussions and technical decisions across the data platform.
Collaborating closely with software engineers, data engineers, infrastructure engineers, and data consumers to deliver high-impact solutions.
Continuously identifying opportunities to simplify systems, improve automation, and reduce operational overhead.
